items.title: 中國人形機器人 佔全球出貨量97% 確立早期領先優勢
items.title_en: Chinese Humanoid Robots Account for 97% of Global Shipments, Cementing Early Lead
paras: 市場研究機構 Smart Analytics Global（SAG）的最新行業數據顯示，2026 年上半年中國人形機器人製造商佔全球 97% 以上的出貨量，凸顯中國在這個新興領域確立早期領先優勢。
據《彭博》10 日（周一）報導，SAG 的數據顯示，2026 年上半年全球人形機器人出貨量約 19,100 台，是去年同期的三倍多。
這家總部位於美國加州的咨詢機構預測，今年全年全球人形機器人出貨量有望攀升至 60,000 台左右，並預計在 2030 年衝刺 50 萬台大關。
數據顯示，總部位於上海的智元機器人今年上半年出貨量達到 8,400 台，佔全球出貨量 44%。總部位於杭州的宇樹科技上半年出貨量為 5,900 台。
這兩家中國人形機器人公司的出貨量均遠超特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 、Figure AI 和 Agility Robotics 等美國一線人形機器人公司，凸顯中國人形機器人產業的發展速度。
與此同時，人形機器人的應用場景正發生轉變。SAG 創始人 Linda Sui 表示：「工業與商業應用已佔到總出貨量 70% 以上，去年僅 50% 左右。」
Linda Sui 說道，監管不確定性和地緣政治風險可能影響該行業下一階段增長。
7 月下旬，美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）以國家安全風險為由，宣布禁止進口外國製造的新型人形機器人，此舉被廣泛視為針對中國。
中國外交部對此表示，中方一貫堅決反對美方泛化國家安全概念，打壓中國企業。保護主義提升不了美國的競爭力，只會損害美國企業和消費者的利益。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Market research firm Smart Analytics Global (SAG) reports that in the first half of 2026, Chinese humanoid robot manufacturers shipped more than 97% of the world’s total, highlighting China’s early‑stage advantage in this emerging field.
According to Bloomberg on Monday the 10th, SAG’s data show that global shipments of humanoid robots in the first half of 2026 were about 19,100 units, more than three times the volume a year earlier.
The California‑based consultancy forecasts that worldwide humanoid robot shipments could rise to roughly 60,000 units for the full year and aims for a surge to 500,000 units by 2030.

Data indicate that Shanghai‑based Zhiyuan Robotics shipped 8,400 units in the first half of the year, representing 44% of global shipments, while Hangzhou‑based Yushu Technology shipped 5,900 units in the same period.

Both Chinese firms’ shipment volumes far exceed those of leading U.S. humanoid robot companies such as Tesla (TSLA‑US), Figure AI and Agility Robotics, underscoring the rapid development of China’s humanoid robot industry.

At the same time, the application scenarios for humanoid robots are shifting. SAG founder Linda Sui said, “Industrial and commercial uses now account for over 70% of total shipments, up from roughly 50% last year.”
Linda Sui added that regulatory uncertainty and geopolitical risks could affect the industry’s next phase of growth.

In late July, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced a ban on importing newly manufactured foreign humanoid robots on national‑security grounds, a move widely seen as targeting China.

China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded that Beijing consistently opposes the U.S. broadening of national‑security concepts to suppress Chinese firms, noting that protectionism does not boost U.S. competitiveness and only harms American businesses and consumers.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 嘉威雙箭頭展現成效 第二季轉盈推升上半年每股純益0.68元
items.title_en: Jia Wei's Double Arrow Effect: Second Quarter Profit Boosts Half-Year EPS to 0.68 NT$
paras: 雖處於傳統第二季的淡季，但嘉威生活 (3557-TW) 今 (10) 日公布的最新獲利資訊，上半年中，受惠美國子公司 FDG 轉型貿易模式，加上 Prepara 品牌效應，帶動上半年較去年同期轉虧為盈，稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。嘉威營運走出谷底。公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
嘉威 2026 年第二季營運明顯回溫，營收達 9.64 億元，年增 34.6％，同時，FDG 營運模式轉型、品牌 Prepara 持續成長，以及母公司成本結構優化，第二季毛利率提升至 37.28%，季增 2.95 個百分點，年增 7.14 個百分點，稅後純益 1635 萬元，季減 59.81%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元。
嘉威上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
嘉威指出，上半年主要來自於美國子公司 FDG 及品牌 Prepara 的雙重貢獻，FDG 今年展現爆發式成長，營收衝上 1.88 億元，較去年同期成長高達 8 倍。同時，Prepara 也繳出穩健成績，上半年營收 9000 萬元，年增 25%，有效提升集團海外通路營收規模。
儘管 2026 年第一季受產能配置調整與成本分攤拉高的影響，毛利率降至 34.33%，但第二季已提高到 37.28%，上半年整體平均毛利率達 35.52%，主要受益於 FDG 轉型為進口商貿易模式，貢獻毛利率增加，另外，嘉威銷貨成本結構優化，也貢獻毛利率增加，使整體獲利結構精進，也證明公司在應對市場挑戰與內部策略調整上均取得實質進展。
嘉威今天同時公布 7 月營收，單月營收 2.11 億元，月 42.62%，年增 1.47％；2026 年 1-7 營收 26.06 億元，年減 10.88%。
本周美國將公布美國 7 月 CPI 及 PPI，市場預期通膨壓力略有減緩，若數據符合預期，聯準會有望繼續維持利率不變；另外，雖然就業數據放緩，但 6 月零售銷售年增率仍達 6.7%，顯示消費者支出依舊穩健。嘉威去年面對關稅不確定性，積極調整體質結構，上半年已展現成效，公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
paras_en: Despite being in the traditional second quarter's off-season, Jia Wei Life (3557-TW) announced its latest profit information today, with the company benefiting from its US subsidiary FDG's transformation of its trading model, as well as the Prepara brand effect, leading to a profit of NT$57 million in the first half of the year, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$. Jia Wei's operations have emerged from the trough.

Jia Wei's 2026 second-quarter operations have clearly rebounded, with revenue reaching NT$964 million, a year-on-year increase of 34.6%. At the same time, FDG's operating model transformation, the continuous growth of the Prepara brand, and the optimization of the parent company's cost structure have led to a second-quarter gross margin of 37.28%, an increase of 2.95 percentage points from the previous quarter and a year-on-year increase of 7.14 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$163.5 million, a decrease of 59.81% from the previous quarter, but an increase of NT$19 million from the same period last year, with an EPS of 0.19 NT$.

Jia Wei's first-half revenue was NT$239.5 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 11.8%, mainly due to the decline in first-quarter revenue. However, with the second-quarter operations gradually recovering, the company's first-half gross margin remained at 35.52%, an increase of 0.27 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit was NT$57 million, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$.

Jia Wei pointed out that the main contribution to the company's first-half performance came from its US subsidiary FDG and the Prepara brand, with FDG showing explosive growth this year, with revenue reaching NT$188 million, an increase of 8 times from the same period last year. At the same time, Prepara also achieved stable performance, with first-half revenue of NT$90 million, a year-on-year increase of 25%, effectively increasing the group's overseas sales channels revenue scale.

Although Jia Wei's 2026 first quarter was affected by production capacity adjustments and cost allocation, the gross margin fell to 34.33%. However, the second quarter has increased to 37.28%, with the company's first-half average gross margin at 35.52%, mainly benefiting from FDG's transformation into an importer trading model, which has contributed to an increase in gross margin, as well as Jia Wei's sales cost structure optimization, which has also contributed to an increase in gross margin, making the company's overall profit structure more refined, and proving that the company has made substantial progress in responding to market challenges and internal strategy adjustments.

Jia Wei announced its July revenue today, with a single-month revenue of NT$2.11 billion, a month-on-month increase of 42.62%, and a year-on-year increase of 1.47%. The company's 1-7 revenue was NT$260.6 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 10.88%.

This week, the US will announce the US July CPI and PPI, with the market expecting a slight easing of inflationary pressure. If the data meets expectations, the Federal Reserve may continue to maintain interest rates unchanged. Although employment data has slowed down, the 6-month retail sales year-on-year growth rate remained at 6.7%, indicating that consumer spending remains stable. Jia Wei faced uncertainty over tariffs last year and actively adjusted its product structure. The company has already shown its effectiveness in the first half of the year and will continue to adjust its pace to respond to changes in the external environment, aiming to achieve better performance in the second half of the year.

items.title: 那指出現創立以來僅18次的罕見信號 這通常意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Rare Signal Triggers in Nasdaq Composite Index
paras: 科技股雲集的那斯達克綜合指數，近期觸發了一個極為罕見的技術信號。自此指數於 1971 年成立以來，此信號僅出現過 18 次，根據歷史經驗，這往往預示著股市在未來一年內將出現驚人的漲幅。

罕見的「連四紅」漲勢

在經歷了 7 月份短暫回落至修正區間的邊緣後，美股隨即被點燃。從 7 月 30 日開始至 8 月 4 日收盤，那斯達克綜合指數連續 4 個交易日每日漲幅均至少達到 1%。這是指數成立 55 年來，第 18 次達成此項壯舉。
根據 Bespoke Investment Group 研究數據，在過去 17 次出現這種連續 4 天漲幅逾 1% 的情況後，那斯達克指數在接下來的一年裡平均飆升了 29.3%，這項數據遠高於該指數過去 55 年來不到 11% 的平均年回報率。

AI 革命與企業盈利雙重驅動

推動 2026 年這波牛市的核心動力，主要來自人工智慧 (AI) 革命以及優於預期的企業盈餘增長。截至 8 月 6 日收盤，那斯達克指數今年以來已上漲 13.4%，領先於標普 500 指數的 12.6% 以及道瓊工業平均指數的 12.1%。
市場分析指出，如果歷史規律再次發揮作用，那斯達克指數有望在 2027 年 8 月前突破 34,000 點大關。
然而，要實現這一歷史性目標，市場需要滿足幾個關鍵條件。首先，AI 基礎設施的建設必須持續推進。目前的 AI 晶片、記憶體與伺服器支出雖然處於高位，但由於許多建設是透過債務融資，若聯準會 (Fed) 持續升息導致借貸成本過高，可能會拖累相關支出。

估值過高與潛在風險

儘管前景樂觀，但投資者仍需保持警惕。目前的股市定價已處於溢價狀態，標普 500 指數的席勒本益比 (Shiller P/E Ratio) 在 6 月初曾一度接近 43，這是歷史上第二貴的市場估值，僅次於網路泡沫時期。這意味著企業必須展現出「近乎完美」的執行力與獲利增長，才能支撐如此高昂的估值。
此外，全球市場的連鎖反應也不容忽視。例如南韓 KOSPI 指數近期出現如「迷因股」般的劇烈波動，這被視為美股潛在的外部風險之一。
paras_en: The Nasdaq Composite Index, which is heavily weighted with tech stocks, recently triggered a rare technical signal. This signal has only appeared 18 times since the index was established in 1971, and historically, it has often predicted a stunning surge in stock prices over the next year.
The rare 'four red' rally

After a brief dip to the correction zone in July, the US stock market was ignited. From July 30 to August 4, the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by at least 1% every day for four consecutive trading days. This is the 18th time the index has achieved this feat in its 55-year history.

According to data from Bespoke Investment Group, in the 17 previous instances where the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by more than 1% for four consecutive days, the index averaged a 29.3% surge over the next year. This is significantly higher than the index's average annual return of less than 11% over the past 55 years.
AI revolution and corporate earnings drive the bull market

The core driver of the 2026 bull market is the AI revolution and better-than-expected corporate earnings growth. As of August 6, the Nasdaq Composite Index has risen 13.4% this year, outperforming the S&P 500 Index's 12.6% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average's 12.1%.
Market analysts say that if historical patterns hold, the Nasdaq Composite Index could break through the 34,000-point barrier by August 2027.

However, to achieve this historic goal, the market must meet several key conditions. First, the construction of AI infrastructure must continue to advance. Although current spending on AI chips, memory, and servers is at a high level, many of these investments are financed through debt, and if the Federal Reserve continues to raise interest rates, leading to high borrowing costs, it could slow down related spending.

items.title_en: 14 Stocks Placed on Trading Suspension from August 11 to 17
paras: 處置股新制起正式上路後，證交所及櫃買中心今 (10) 日公告首波 14 檔處置股，包括愛普 * (6531-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、晶豪科(3006)、大量(3167-TW) 等 9 檔上市股，5 檔上櫃股包括富喬 (3450-TW)、聯亞(3081-TW)、中探針(6217-TW)、鈺創(5351-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)。14 檔個股自明(11) 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，股票交易撮合時間調整為每 2 分鐘一次，至 8 月 17 日出關。
9 檔上市股遭列為處置股，包括吉祥全 (2491-TW、晶豪科、大量 (3167-TW)、聯鈞、聯茂 (6213-TW)、訊芯 - KY(6451-TW)、愛普 *、聯友金屬 - 創 (7610-TW)、尖點 (8021-TW)。
晶豪科處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 44.48%。且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 77.5 元。
吉祥權處置原因最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 43.86％。
愛普 * 大量處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 33.89%，且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 190 元。
另有 5 檔上櫃股中包括富喬、聯亞、中探針、鈺創及 IET-KY。14 檔個股自 8 月 11 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，交易撮合時間經新制調整後，為每 2 分鐘一次。
愛普 * 在本周召開法說會並公布 7 月營收，不僅釋出未來數年樂觀展望，7 月營收更達 11.04 億元，創下歷史新高，今日股價開高走低，跌 2.94％。愛普 * 公司看好，隨著 IoTRAM 應用市場持續擴展、產品組合將持續優化，在三大產品線成長動能延續，預期未來幾年，營收有望以倍數成長。
記憶體 IC 設計大廠晶豪科則是受惠於記憶體市場供需結構大幅改善及產品價格強勁上揚， 7 月單月營收高達 67.85 億元、月增 40.02%、年增 491.06%，連續刷新單月歷史新高。晶豪科今日在外資連 6 買挹注下，股價也收漲 7.41％。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) and the Taiwan Stock Exchange's over-the-counter (OTC) market announced the first batch of 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension, including 9 listed stocks and 5 OTC stocks, on August 10.

The 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension include Epistar Corp (6531-TW), Lianzhong Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW), Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW), and 5 other listed stocks.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 44.48% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$77.5 between the 6th and 8th trading days.
Jixiang Group Co Ltd (2491-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 43.86% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) and Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW) were placed on trading suspension due to a 33.89% increase in their closing prices over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$190 between the 6th and 8th trading days.

In addition to the 9 listed stocks, 5 OTC stocks, including Fuzhao Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Lianya Enterprise Co Ltd (3081-TW), Zhongtan Needle Co Ltd (6217-TW), Yuexin Technology Co Ltd (5351-TW), and IET-KY Co Ltd (4971-TW), were also placed on trading suspension.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) held a conference call on August 10 and announced its July revenue, which reached NT$11.04 billion, a new historical high. The company's stock price opened high and fell 2.94% today.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) benefited from the significant improvement in the memory market's supply and demand structure and the strong increase in product prices. Its July monthly revenue reached NT$67.85 billion, up 40.02% from the previous month and 491.06% from the same period last year, setting a new historical high. The company's stock price rose 7.41% today, with foreign investors buying for 6 consecutive days.

items.title: 挑戰台積電還要更多銀彈！英特爾發股募資150億美元
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering to Fund Chip Expansion
paras: 美國晶片大廠英特爾 (Intel)(INTC-US) 周一 (10 日) 宣布，計劃透過發行股票籌資 150 億美元，藉由今年來股價大幅上漲的機會，為成本高昂的晶圓代工事業擴張計畫補充資金。
英特爾曾是全球半導體產業的主導者，如今正大舉投資新廠及先進封裝技術，希望在晶圓代工領域追趕台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 等市場領導者。建立先進製程產能需要投入龐大資本，這次股票發行將為其轉型及擴產計畫提供更多財務空間。
受到股票發行可能稀釋現有股東持股及每股獲利的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌逾 3%。不過，受惠於投資人看好公司重整及轉型進展，英特爾股價今年以來已上漲超過一倍，表現優於多數同業，也讓公司得以趁股價處於高檔時籌措資金。
根據發行安排，英特爾還將提供承銷商一項為期 30 天的選擇權，可按照發行價扣除承銷折扣後，額外購買最高 22.5 億美元的股票。若承銷商全數行使選擇權，英特爾此次籌資規模最高可達 172.5 億美元。
摩根大通證券、高盛、摩根士丹利及花旗環球金融將共同擔任本次股票發行的聯席簿記管理人。
paras_en: US chipmaker Intel (INTC-US) announced on Monday that it plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering, taking advantage of the significant price increase this year to supplement funds for its costly chip manufacturing expansion plans.

Intel, once the leader in the global semiconductor industry, is now heavily investing in new factories and advanced packaging technology in a bid to catch up with market leaders such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSM-US)(2330-TW). Building advanced process capacity requires massive capital investment, and this stock offering will provide more financial space for its transformation and expansion plans.

Intel's stock price fell over 3% on Monday ahead of the stock offering, due to concerns over the potential dilution of existing shareholders' stakes and earnings per share. However, investors are optimistic about the company's restructuring and transformation progress, which has led to a more than doubling of its stock price this year, outperforming many of its peers and enabling the company to raise funds at a high price.

Under the issuance arrangement, Intel will also provide underwriters with a 30-day option to purchase an additional $2.25 billion in stock, after deducting the underwriting discount from the issuance price. If the underwriters exercise the option in full, Intel's total fundraising scale could reach $17.25 billion.
Morgan Stanley Securities, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JPMorgan Chase will jointly serve as the joint bookrunners for this stock offering.

items.title: 資產處分活化、油品雙引擎挹注  北基上半年EPS 0.62元已賺贏去年全年
items.title_en: Asset Disposal Boosts, Oil Product Dual-Engine Injection: North Base's First Half EPS 0.62 Yuan Already Surpassed Last Year's Full-Year
paras: 北基 (8927-TW) 今 (10) 日公告自結今年上半年財報及 7 月營收，北基上半年受惠資產活化策略持續發揮效益，稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍，每股稅後盈餘達 0.62 元，不僅較去 (2025) 年同期大幅成長，更已超越去年全年度獲利，也創歷年同期次高記錄，
北基上半年合併營收達 76.37 億元、年增 51.11％，改寫歷年同期新高；稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍；毛利率為 16％、年減 0.4 個百分比；營業利益率年增約 2.1 個百分比。
北基指出，上半年獲利大幅躍升，主要受惠土地建設事業資產活化策略持續發揮效益，包括出售高雄市鼓山區龍中段、高雄市三民區澄東段及桃園市三民段、台南市安平區國安段等營建用地，帶動上半年土地建設業務營收比重較去年同期的 12％攀升至 37％。
其次，旗下核心油品事業銷售亦同步年增 9.3％，因集團於全台加油站覆蓋率持續提升，挹注發油量年增約 1.14％，加上國際油價上漲，帶動上半年平均油價明顯高於去年同期，隨著整體業務組合結構調整，優化集團整體營運效率。
此外，北基也自結 7 月營收為 8.38 億元、月減 39.8％、年增 6.55％，創歷年同期次高。北基表示，7 月因土地處分案認列時點不若上半年密集而較上月下滑，累計今年 1 至 7 月合併營收達 84.75 億元、年增 45.43％，續創歷年同期新高。
展望今年第三季，北基表示，將持審慎樂觀看法，油品事業仍為集團核心營運基礎，隨著暑期用油需求、民生消費活動及車流回升，持續透過站點營運效率提升、服務品質優化及據點布局精進，穩固油品銷售表現，同時集團亦將持續推進光電綠能、土地建設資產活化等多元事業布局，深化集團多角化經營利基，並創造未來營運良好動能。
paras_en: North Base (8927-TW) announced today (10) that it has concluded its first-half financial report and July revenue. North Base's first-half performance benefited from the continued effectiveness of its asset activation strategy, with a net profit of NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year, and a net profit per share of NT$0.62, surpassing last year's full-year profit and setting a record for the second-highest in history.

North Base's first-half consolidated revenue reached NT$763.7 billion, a 51.11% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high. The net profit was NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year. The gross margin was 16%, a 0.4 percentage point decrease from the same period last year, and the operating profit margin increased by approximately 2.1 percentage points.

North Base pointed out that the significant increase in profits in the first half was mainly due to the continued effectiveness of the asset activation strategy in the land development business, including the sale of land in Kaohsiung City's Gushan District, Kaohsiung City's Sanmin District, Taoyuan City's Sanmin District, and Tainan City's Anping District, which drove the land development business revenue to increase by 37% compared to the same period last year.

Secondly, the core oil product business of the company also saw a 9.3% increase in sales, as the group's coverage rate of gas stations across Taiwan continued to improve, injecting an increase of approximately 1.14% in fuel sales, and with the international oil price rising, the average oil price in the first half was significantly higher than the same period last year. With the overall business structure adjustment and optimization of the group's overall operating efficiency.

In addition, North Base also announced that its July revenue was NT$838 million, a 39.8% decrease from the previous month and a 6.55% increase from the same period last year, setting a record for the second-highest in history. North Base stated that the 7th month was due to the recognition of land disposal cases at a slower pace than the first half, resulting in a decline from the previous month, and the cumulative revenue from January to July was NT$847.5 billion, a 45.43% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, North Base stated that it will maintain a cautious and optimistic view, with the oil product business remaining the core operating foundation of the group. With the increase in summer fuel demand, consumer spending, and traffic flow, the group will continue to improve station operating efficiency, service quality, and site layout, to stabilize oil sales performance, while also continuing to promote diversified business layouts such as solar energy, green energy, and land development asset activation, to deepen the group's multi-industry operation and create future operating momentum.

items.title: 日元干預效果遞減 8月表現為G10貨幣最差 市場靜待日銀下步行動
items.title_en: Yen Intervention Effect Fades, August Performance Worst Among G10 Currencies
paras: 日元匯率在經歷了 7 月的強勁反彈後，8 月份再度陷入疲軟。儘管日本與美國近期聯手進行了自 1998 年以來的首次協同干預，但隨著干預效應消退，日元本月表現遜於所有 G10 成員國。
根據數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率在 8 月已下跌約 0.9%，部分回吐了 7 月份約 3.2% 的漲幅。此前美日當局在日元貶至近 164 的四十年低點後出手，一度將匯率推升至 155 附近，但目前已回落至 158.85。
據分析，日本當局在 7 月 30 日與 31 日分別斥資約 530 億及 340 億美元進行干預，若 7 月 30 日的數據獲得證實，將創下史上最大單日干預紀錄。
高盛與野村證券的分析師指出，日元持續承壓的主因在於美日間巨大的利差、對日本財政支出的擔憂以及地緣政治的不確定性。即使東京與華盛頓官方警告準備再次行動，分析師認為若全球環境或政策未出現重大轉向，日元貶值壓力恐將持續存在。
此外，日本銀行 7 月會議意見摘要顯示，通膨風險正在升溫，甚至有委員提議加速升息。目前換匯市場預期 9 月升息的機率約 63%，而 10 月升息則幾乎被完全定價。
由於目前適逢日本盂蘭盆節假期，市場參與度降低且流動性變薄，交易員正密切警惕當局是否會利用此時機再次出手干預。
paras_en: The yen has weakened in August after a strong rebound in July, despite Japan and the US conducting their first joint intervention since 1998. The intervention effect has worn off, and the yen's performance this month has been the worst among all G10 member countries.

Data shows the yen has fallen about 0.9% against the dollar in August, partly reversing the 3.2% gain in July. The intervention had pushed the exchange rate up to around 155, but it has since fallen back to 158.85. The authorities intervened after the yen hit a 40-year low of nearly 164.

Analysts say Japan intervened on July 30 and 31, spending around $53 billion and $34 billion, respectively. If the July 30 data is confirmed, it would set a record for the largest single-day intervention in history.

Analysts at Goldman Sachs and Nomura Securities say the yen's continued weakness is due to the large interest rate differential between the US and Japan, concerns over Japan's fiscal spending, and geopolitical uncertainty. Even with official warnings from Tokyo and Washington that they are prepared to intervene again, analysts believe that the yen's depreciation pressure will persist unless there is a significant shift in the global environment or policy.

The Bank of Japan's July meeting minutes showed that inflation risks are rising, with some committee members suggesting accelerating interest rate hikes. Market expectations are for a 63% chance of a rate hike in September and almost complete pricing for a rate hike in October.
With the Obon holiday in Japan, market participation is lower and liquidity is thinner, and traders are closely watching whether the authorities will use this opportunity to intervene again.

items.title: 嘉威雙箭頭展現成效 第二季轉盈推升上半年每股純益0.68元
items.title_en: Jia Wei's Double Arrow Effect: Second Quarter Profit Boosts Half-Year EPS to 0.68 NT$
paras: 雖處於傳統第二季的淡季，但嘉威生活 (3557-TW) 今 (10) 日公布的最新獲利資訊，上半年中，受惠美國子公司 FDG 轉型貿易模式，加上 Prepara 品牌效應，帶動上半年較去年同期轉虧為盈，稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。嘉威營運走出谷底。公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
嘉威 2026 年第二季營運明顯回溫，營收達 9.64 億元，年增 34.6％，同時，FDG 營運模式轉型、品牌 Prepara 持續成長，以及母公司成本結構優化，第二季毛利率提升至 37.28%，季增 2.95 個百分點，年增 7.14 個百分點，稅後純益 1635 萬元，季減 59.81%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元。
嘉威上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
嘉威指出，上半年主要來自於美國子公司 FDG 及品牌 Prepara 的雙重貢獻，FDG 今年展現爆發式成長，營收衝上 1.88 億元，較去年同期成長高達 8 倍。同時，Prepara 也繳出穩健成績，上半年營收 9000 萬元，年增 25%，有效提升集團海外通路營收規模。
儘管 2026 年第一季受產能配置調整與成本分攤拉高的影響，毛利率降至 34.33%，但第二季已提高到 37.28%，上半年整體平均毛利率達 35.52%，主要受益於 FDG 轉型為進口商貿易模式，貢獻毛利率增加，另外，嘉威銷貨成本結構優化，也貢獻毛利率增加，使整體獲利結構精進，也證明公司在應對市場挑戰與內部策略調整上均取得實質進展。
嘉威今天同時公布 7 月營收，單月營收 2.11 億元，月 42.62%，年增 1.47％；2026 年 1-7 營收 26.06 億元，年減 10.88%。
本周美國將公布美國 7 月 CPI 及 PPI，市場預期通膨壓力略有減緩，若數據符合預期，聯準會有望繼續維持利率不變；另外，雖然就業數據放緩，但 6 月零售銷售年增率仍達 6.7%，顯示消費者支出依舊穩健。嘉威去年面對關稅不確定性，積極調整體質結構，上半年已展現成效，公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
paras_en: Despite being in the traditional second quarter's off-season, Jia Wei Life (3557-TW) announced its latest profit information today, with the company benefiting from its US subsidiary FDG's transformation of its trading model, as well as the Prepara brand effect, leading to a profit of NT$57 million in the first half of the year, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$. Jia Wei's operations have emerged from the trough.

Jia Wei's 2026 second-quarter operations have clearly rebounded, with revenue reaching NT$964 million, a year-on-year increase of 34.6%. At the same time, FDG's operating model transformation, the continuous growth of the Prepara brand, and the optimization of the parent company's cost structure have led to a second-quarter gross margin of 37.28%, an increase of 2.95 percentage points from the previous quarter and a year-on-year increase of 7.14 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$163.5 million, a decrease of 59.81% from the previous quarter, but an increase of NT$19 million from the same period last year, with an EPS of 0.19 NT$.

Jia Wei's first-half revenue was NT$239.5 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 11.8%, mainly due to the decline in first-quarter revenue. However, with the second-quarter operations gradually recovering, the company's first-half gross margin remained at 35.52%, an increase of 0.27 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit was NT$57 million, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$.

Jia Wei pointed out that the main contribution to the company's first-half performance came from its US subsidiary FDG and the Prepara brand, with FDG showing explosive growth this year, with revenue reaching NT$188 million, an increase of 8 times from the same period last year. At the same time, Prepara also achieved stable performance, with first-half revenue of NT$90 million, a year-on-year increase of 25%, effectively increasing the group's overseas sales channels revenue scale.

Although Jia Wei's 2026 first quarter was affected by production capacity adjustments and cost allocation, the gross margin fell to 34.33%. However, the second quarter has increased to 37.28%, with the company's first-half average gross margin at 35.52%, mainly benefiting from FDG's transformation into an importer trading model, which has contributed to an increase in gross margin, as well as Jia Wei's sales cost structure optimization, which has also contributed to an increase in gross margin, making the company's overall profit structure more refined, and proving that the company has made substantial progress in responding to market challenges and internal strategy adjustments.

Jia Wei announced its July revenue today, with a single-month revenue of NT$2.11 billion, a month-on-month increase of 42.62%, and a year-on-year increase of 1.47%. The company's 1-7 revenue was NT$260.6 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 10.88%.

This week, the US will announce the US July CPI and PPI, with the market expecting a slight easing of inflationary pressure. If the data meets expectations, the Federal Reserve may continue to maintain interest rates unchanged. Although employment data has slowed down, the 6-month retail sales year-on-year growth rate remained at 6.7%, indicating that consumer spending remains stable. Jia Wei faced uncertainty over tariffs last year and actively adjusted its product structure. The company has already shown its effectiveness in the first half of the year and will continue to adjust its pace to respond to changes in the external environment, aiming to achieve better performance in the second half of the year.

items.title: 上市櫃14檔處置股明起齊被關 愛普*、晶豪科漲很大遭關禁閉至8/17
items.title_en: 14 Stocks Placed on Trading Suspension from August 11 to 17
paras: 處置股新制起正式上路後，證交所及櫃買中心今 (10) 日公告首波 14 檔處置股，包括愛普 * (6531-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、晶豪科(3006)、大量(3167-TW) 等 9 檔上市股，5 檔上櫃股包括富喬 (3450-TW)、聯亞(3081-TW)、中探針(6217-TW)、鈺創(5351-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)。14 檔個股自明(11) 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，股票交易撮合時間調整為每 2 分鐘一次，至 8 月 17 日出關。
9 檔上市股遭列為處置股，包括吉祥全 (2491-TW、晶豪科、大量 (3167-TW)、聯鈞、聯茂 (6213-TW)、訊芯 - KY(6451-TW)、愛普 *、聯友金屬 - 創 (7610-TW)、尖點 (8021-TW)。
晶豪科處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 44.48%。且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 77.5 元。
吉祥權處置原因最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 43.86％。
愛普 * 大量處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 33.89%，且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 190 元。
另有 5 檔上櫃股中包括富喬、聯亞、中探針、鈺創及 IET-KY。14 檔個股自 8 月 11 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，交易撮合時間經新制調整後，為每 2 分鐘一次。
愛普 * 在本周召開法說會並公布 7 月營收，不僅釋出未來數年樂觀展望，7 月營收更達 11.04 億元，創下歷史新高，今日股價開高走低，跌 2.94％。愛普 * 公司看好，隨著 IoTRAM 應用市場持續擴展、產品組合將持續優化，在三大產品線成長動能延續，預期未來幾年，營收有望以倍數成長。
記憶體 IC 設計大廠晶豪科則是受惠於記憶體市場供需結構大幅改善及產品價格強勁上揚， 7 月單月營收高達 67.85 億元、月增 40.02%、年增 491.06%，連續刷新單月歷史新高。晶豪科今日在外資連 6 買挹注下，股價也收漲 7.41％。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) and the Taiwan Stock Exchange's over-the-counter (OTC) market announced the first batch of 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension, including 9 listed stocks and 5 OTC stocks, on August 10.

The 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension include Epistar Corp (6531-TW), Lianzhong Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW), Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW), and 5 other listed stocks.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 44.48% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$77.5 between the 6th and 8th trading days.
Jixiang Group Co Ltd (2491-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 43.86% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) and Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW) were placed on trading suspension due to a 33.89% increase in their closing prices over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$190 between the 6th and 8th trading days.

In addition to the 9 listed stocks, 5 OTC stocks, including Fuzhao Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Lianya Enterprise Co Ltd (3081-TW), Zhongtan Needle Co Ltd (6217-TW), Yuexin Technology Co Ltd (5351-TW), and IET-KY Co Ltd (4971-TW), were also placed on trading suspension.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) held a conference call on August 10 and announced its July revenue, which reached NT$11.04 billion, a new historical high. The company's stock price opened high and fell 2.94% today.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) benefited from the significant improvement in the memory market's supply and demand structure and the strong increase in product prices. Its July monthly revenue reached NT$67.85 billion, up 40.02% from the previous month and 491.06% from the same period last year, setting a new historical high. The company's stock price rose 7.41% today, with foreign investors buying for 6 consecutive days.

items.title: PSA華科事業群攜北科大產學合作 聚焦AI技術研發與人才培育兩大面向
items.title_en: PSA Huake Business Group Partners with National Taipei University of Technology for Industry-Academia Collaboration, Focusing on AI R&D and Talent Development
paras: PSA 華科事業群與國立臺北科技大學今 (10) 日簽署產學合作計畫，共同宣布啟動為期三年、總投入 5,000 萬元的合作案，預計自 2026 年第四季正式展開，將聚焦 AI 技術研發與人才培育兩大面向。
簽約儀式由 PSA 華科事業群董事長焦佑衡與國立臺北科技大學校長任貽均共同代表簽署，教育部次長劉國偉應邀出席見證，象徵產官學攜手推動 AI 技術研發與人才培育，共同深化產學合作。
焦佑衡致詞時表示，台灣出生率持續下降，人才培育已成為企業永續發展的重要課題，AI 正快速改變全球產業發展模式，企業競爭力除了來自技術創新，更取決於人才的培育與累積，而台灣擁有優良的大學教育、安全的社會環境、健全的醫療體系，以及完整的科技產業鏈，具備吸引國際人才來台發展的優勢。
焦佑衡指出，企業除了提供具競爭力的薪資與良好的發展環境，也應持續投入人才培育，吸引優秀人才留在台灣、在台灣發展，此次與北科大合作希望整合雙方資源，提早培育具備專業能力、國際視野及實作經驗的人才，讓優秀人才與企業共同成長，並將科技創新的力量回饋產業與社會。
任貽均表示，北科大與 PSA 華科事業群合作淵源深厚，自 2018 年華新科加入北科大國際產學聯盟以來，雙方持續推動產學合作，2019 年更攜手將工業 4.0 智慧製造技術導入 PSA 馬來西亞生產基地，奠定良好的合作基礎，此次合作將進一步深化 AI 技術研發與人才培育，攜手打造產學共創新典範。
華科事業群長期深耕被動元件、PCB、EMS、能源及半導體封裝測試等領域，產品應用相當多元，從日常生活、AI 伺服器，到醫療 MRI 設備、日本新幹線等領域，近年更積極推動 AI 技術導入智慧製造、研發設計及營運管理。
此次與北科大的產學合作，參與企業包含華新科、華東、瀚宇博、精成科、佳邦等，雙方以華科事業群 AI 專案需求為出發點，共同推動 AI 相關技術研究與應用開發，促進創新技術落地，提升企業智慧製造、研發及營運效率，並透過完善的產學合作機制，培養未來所需的專業技術人才，建立從校園到職場的接軌機制。
paras_en: PSA Huake Business Group and National Taipei University of Technology signed an industry-academia cooperation plan today (the 10th), announcing the launch of a three-year collaboration with a total investment of NT$50 million, scheduled to commence in the fourth quarter of 2026, focusing on AI technology research and development as well as talent cultivation.

The signing ceremony was attended by PSA Huake Business Group Chairman Jiao Youheng and NTUT President Ren Yijun, who signed on behalf of their organizations, with Deputy Minister of Education Liu Guowei invited to witness the event, symbolizing the joint effort of industry, government, and academia to promote AI technology R&D and talent development and deepen industry‑academia cooperation.

In his remarks, Jiao Youheng noted that Taiwan's birth rate continues to decline, making talent cultivation a critical issue for corporate sustainability. AI is rapidly reshaping global industry development models, and a company's competitiveness depends not only on technological innovation but also on the training and accumulation of talent. He highlighted Taiwan's strengths—high‑quality university education, a safe social environment, a robust healthcare system, and a complete technology industry chain—as advantages for attracting international talent to develop in Taiwan.

Jiao emphasized that companies should not only offer competitive salaries and a good development environment but also continuously invest in talent cultivation to retain top talent in Taiwan. The partnership with NTUT aims to integrate resources from both sides to nurture professionals with expertise, international perspective, and hands‑on experience early on, allowing outstanding talent and enterprises to grow together and channel the power of technological innovation back to industry and society.

Ren Yijun said that the cooperation between NTUT and PSA Huake Business Group has deep roots. Since Huaxin Ke joined NTUT’s International Industry‑Academia Alliance in 2018, the two sides have continuously promoted collaboration, and in 2019 they jointly introduced Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing technology to PSA’s production base in Malaysia, laying a solid foundation. This new partnership will further deepen AI technology R&D and talent cultivation, jointly creating a new model of industry‑academia co‑innovation.

Huake Business Group has long been engaged in passive components, PCBs, EMS, energy, and semiconductor packaging and testing, with a diverse range of product applications—from everyday life and AI servers to medical MRI equipment and Japan’s Shinkansen. In recent years, the group has actively promoted the integration of AI technology into smart manufacturing, R&D design, and operational management.

The industry‑academia collaboration with NTUT involves companies such as Huaxin Ke, Huadong, Hanyu Bo, Jingcheng Ke, and Jiabang. Starting from the AI project needs of the Huake Business Group, both sides will jointly advance AI‑related technology research and application development, facilitating the implementation of innovative technologies, enhancing smart manufacturing, R&D, and operational efficiency, and through a comprehensive cooperation mechanism, cultivate the professional technical talent needed for the future, establishing a seamless pipeline from campus to the workplace.

items.title: 資產處分活化、油品雙引擎挹注  北基上半年EPS 0.62元已賺贏去年全年
items.title_en: Asset Disposal Boosts, Oil Product Dual-Engine Injection: North Base's First Half EPS 0.62 Yuan Already Surpassed Last Year's Full-Year
paras: 北基 (8927-TW) 今 (10) 日公告自結今年上半年財報及 7 月營收，北基上半年受惠資產活化策略持續發揮效益，稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍，每股稅後盈餘達 0.62 元，不僅較去 (2025) 年同期大幅成長，更已超越去年全年度獲利，也創歷年同期次高記錄，
北基上半年合併營收達 76.37 億元、年增 51.11％，改寫歷年同期新高；稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍；毛利率為 16％、年減 0.4 個百分比；營業利益率年增約 2.1 個百分比。
北基指出，上半年獲利大幅躍升，主要受惠土地建設事業資產活化策略持續發揮效益，包括出售高雄市鼓山區龍中段、高雄市三民區澄東段及桃園市三民段、台南市安平區國安段等營建用地，帶動上半年土地建設業務營收比重較去年同期的 12％攀升至 37％。
其次，旗下核心油品事業銷售亦同步年增 9.3％，因集團於全台加油站覆蓋率持續提升，挹注發油量年增約 1.14％，加上國際油價上漲，帶動上半年平均油價明顯高於去年同期，隨著整體業務組合結構調整，優化集團整體營運效率。
此外，北基也自結 7 月營收為 8.38 億元、月減 39.8％、年增 6.55％，創歷年同期次高。北基表示，7 月因土地處分案認列時點不若上半年密集而較上月下滑，累計今年 1 至 7 月合併營收達 84.75 億元、年增 45.43％，續創歷年同期新高。
展望今年第三季，北基表示，將持審慎樂觀看法，油品事業仍為集團核心營運基礎，隨著暑期用油需求、民生消費活動及車流回升，持續透過站點營運效率提升、服務品質優化及據點布局精進，穩固油品銷售表現，同時集團亦將持續推進光電綠能、土地建設資產活化等多元事業布局，深化集團多角化經營利基，並創造未來營運良好動能。
paras_en: North Base (8927-TW) announced today (10) that it has concluded its first-half financial report and July revenue. North Base's first-half performance benefited from the continued effectiveness of its asset activation strategy, with a net profit of NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year, and a net profit per share of NT$0.62, surpassing last year's full-year profit and setting a record for the second-highest in history.

North Base's first-half consolidated revenue reached NT$763.7 billion, a 51.11% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high. The net profit was NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year. The gross margin was 16%, a 0.4 percentage point decrease from the same period last year, and the operating profit margin increased by approximately 2.1 percentage points.

North Base pointed out that the significant increase in profits in the first half was mainly due to the continued effectiveness of the asset activation strategy in the land development business, including the sale of land in Kaohsiung City's Gushan District, Kaohsiung City's Sanmin District, Taoyuan City's Sanmin District, and Tainan City's Anping District, which drove the land development business revenue to increase by 37% compared to the same period last year.

Secondly, the core oil product business of the company also saw a 9.3% increase in sales, as the group's coverage rate of gas stations across Taiwan continued to improve, injecting an increase of approximately 1.14% in fuel sales, and with the international oil price rising, the average oil price in the first half was significantly higher than the same period last year. With the overall business structure adjustment and optimization of the group's overall operating efficiency.

In addition, North Base also announced that its July revenue was NT$838 million, a 39.8% decrease from the previous month and a 6.55% increase from the same period last year, setting a record for the second-highest in history. North Base stated that the 7th month was due to the recognition of land disposal cases at a slower pace than the first half, resulting in a decline from the previous month, and the cumulative revenue from January to July was NT$847.5 billion, a 45.43% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, North Base stated that it will maintain a cautious and optimistic view, with the oil product business remaining the core operating foundation of the group. With the increase in summer fuel demand, consumer spending, and traffic flow, the group will continue to improve station operating efficiency, service quality, and site layout, to stabilize oil sales performance, while also continuing to promote diversified business layouts such as solar energy, green energy, and land development asset activation, to deepen the group's multi-industry operation and create future operating momentum.

items.title: 英特爾趁股價翻倍啟動150億美元募資 擴大晶圓代工與先進封裝投資
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering Amid Surging Share Price
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國晶片大廠英特爾Intel(INTC-US)周一宣布，計畫透過發行股票籌集150億美元資金。隨著公司轉型策略帶動今年股價大幅上漲，英特爾選擇把握股價走強時機籌措資金，以支應資本密集度高的晶圓代工業務擴張。
英特爾過去曾是全球晶片產業的主導廠商，但近年面臨競爭加劇，公司正投入大量資金興建新廠，並強化先進封裝能力，希望擴大晶圓代工市場版圖，與產業龍頭台積電(2330-TW)競爭。
受到新股發行可能稀釋既有股東持股的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌超過3%。不過，在轉型題材推動下，英特爾今年以來股價已上漲超過一倍，表現優於同業，也為公司此時進行大規模股權募資提供有利條件。
根據募資規劃，英特爾將允許承銷商在未來30天內，視市場需求額外購買最多22.5億美元的英特爾股票。如果市場認購反應熱絡、承銷商全數行使這項權利，英特爾最終透過此次股票發行籌集的資金規模，最高募資金額可達172.5億美元。
英特爾Intel先前預期2026年資本支出約與2025年持平，但隨著AI帶動CPU需求升溫，訂單已超過現有製造產能，公司因此在7月將2026年資本支出預估從180億上調至200億美元，加快擴充產能。
相較之下，此次基本募資規模已接近公司一整年的資本支出，對現有股東來說，大規模發行新股將增加流通在外股數，在其他條件不變下，將對每股盈餘帶來稀釋壓力；但從另一個角度來看，公司積極募資，也代表英特爾正在為後續投資預先準備資金，市場將關注這是否反映公司對未來訂單能見度更有信心，並可能進一步上修資本支出、加快擴產腳步。
英特爾近年持續增加新製程、晶圓廠設備與先進封裝相關投資，希望透過擴充製造能力重新建立競爭優勢。今年股價大幅反彈，也讓公司得以把握股價走高的機會，透過資本市場籌措更多資金，降低大規模擴產對自身現金部位帶來的壓力。

paras_en: On August 10, 2026, Intel (INTC-US), a US chip giant, announced plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering. With the company's transformation strategy driving a significant surge in its stock price this year, Intel is taking advantage of the strong market to raise funds for its capital-intensive foundry business expansion.

Intel, once the dominant player in the global chip industry, has faced increasing competition in recent years. The company is investing heavily in building new factories and strengthening its advanced packaging capabilities to expand its foundry market share and compete with industry leader TSMC (2330-TW).

Intel's stock price fell by over 3% in pre-market trading on Monday due to concerns that the new stock offering might dilute existing shareholders' holdings. However, driven by its transformation, Intel's stock price has more than doubled this year, outperforming its peers and providing favorable conditions for the company's large-scale equity financing.

According to the fundraising plan, Intel will allow underwriters to purchase an additional $2.25 billion of its stock within the next 30 days, depending on market demand. If the market response is strong and the underwriters exercise this option in full, Intel's total fundraising amount could reach $17.25 billion.

Intel had previously expected its 2026 capital expenditures to be similar to those in 2025. However, with AI-driven CPU demand heating up, orders have exceeded current manufacturing capacity, prompting the company to revise its 2026 capital expenditure estimate from $18 billion to $20 billion in July to accelerate capacity expansion.

In comparison, the basic fundraising amount is close to the company's annual capital expenditure. For existing shareholders, the large-scale issuance of new shares will increase the number of outstanding shares, which may lead to a dilution of earnings per share, assuming other conditions remain unchanged. On the other hand, the company's proactive fundraising efforts may indicate that Intel is preparing funds for future investments, and the market will be watching to see if this reflects the company's increased confidence in its future orders and potential further expansion.

Intel has been increasing its investments in new processes, wafer factory equipment, and advanced packaging in recent years to re-establish its competitive advantage through expanded manufacturing capabilities. This year's significant stock price rebound has also enabled the company to take advantage of the high stock price to raise more funds through the capital market, reducing the pressure on its cash position due to large-scale expansion.

items.title: 那指出現創立以來僅18次的罕見信號 這通常意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Rare Signal Triggers in Nasdaq Composite Index
paras: 科技股雲集的那斯達克綜合指數，近期觸發了一個極為罕見的技術信號。自此指數於 1971 年成立以來，此信號僅出現過 18 次，根據歷史經驗，這往往預示著股市在未來一年內將出現驚人的漲幅。

罕見的「連四紅」漲勢

在經歷了 7 月份短暫回落至修正區間的邊緣後，美股隨即被點燃。從 7 月 30 日開始至 8 月 4 日收盤，那斯達克綜合指數連續 4 個交易日每日漲幅均至少達到 1%。這是指數成立 55 年來，第 18 次達成此項壯舉。
根據 Bespoke Investment Group 研究數據，在過去 17 次出現這種連續 4 天漲幅逾 1% 的情況後，那斯達克指數在接下來的一年裡平均飆升了 29.3%，這項數據遠高於該指數過去 55 年來不到 11% 的平均年回報率。

AI 革命與企業盈利雙重驅動

推動 2026 年這波牛市的核心動力，主要來自人工智慧 (AI) 革命以及優於預期的企業盈餘增長。截至 8 月 6 日收盤，那斯達克指數今年以來已上漲 13.4%，領先於標普 500 指數的 12.6% 以及道瓊工業平均指數的 12.1%。
市場分析指出，如果歷史規律再次發揮作用，那斯達克指數有望在 2027 年 8 月前突破 34,000 點大關。
然而，要實現這一歷史性目標，市場需要滿足幾個關鍵條件。首先，AI 基礎設施的建設必須持續推進。目前的 AI 晶片、記憶體與伺服器支出雖然處於高位，但由於許多建設是透過債務融資，若聯準會 (Fed) 持續升息導致借貸成本過高，可能會拖累相關支出。

估值過高與潛在風險

儘管前景樂觀，但投資者仍需保持警惕。目前的股市定價已處於溢價狀態，標普 500 指數的席勒本益比 (Shiller P/E Ratio) 在 6 月初曾一度接近 43，這是歷史上第二貴的市場估值，僅次於網路泡沫時期。這意味著企業必須展現出「近乎完美」的執行力與獲利增長，才能支撐如此高昂的估值。
此外，全球市場的連鎖反應也不容忽視。例如南韓 KOSPI 指數近期出現如「迷因股」般的劇烈波動，這被視為美股潛在的外部風險之一。
paras_en: The Nasdaq Composite Index, which is heavily weighted with tech stocks, recently triggered a rare technical signal. This signal has only appeared 18 times since the index was established in 1971, and historically, it has often predicted a stunning surge in stock prices over the next year.
The rare 'four red' rally

After a brief dip to the correction zone in July, the US stock market was ignited. From July 30 to August 4, the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by at least 1% every day for four consecutive trading days. This is the 18th time the index has achieved this feat in its 55-year history.

According to data from Bespoke Investment Group, in the 17 previous instances where the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by more than 1% for four consecutive days, the index averaged a 29.3% surge over the next year. This is significantly higher than the index's average annual return of less than 11% over the past 55 years.
AI revolution and corporate earnings drive the bull market

The core driver of the 2026 bull market is the AI revolution and better-than-expected corporate earnings growth. As of August 6, the Nasdaq Composite Index has risen 13.4% this year, outperforming the S&P 500 Index's 12.6% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average's 12.1%.
Market analysts say that if historical patterns hold, the Nasdaq Composite Index could break through the 34,000-point barrier by August 2027.

However, to achieve this historic goal, the market must meet several key conditions. First, the construction of AI infrastructure must continue to advance. Although current spending on AI chips, memory, and servers is at a high level, many of these investments are financed through debt, and if the Federal Reserve continues to raise interest rates, leading to high borrowing costs, it could slow down related spending.

items.title: 挑戰台積電還要更多銀彈！英特爾發股募資150億美元
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering to Fund Chip Expansion
paras: 美國晶片大廠英特爾 (Intel)(INTC-US) 周一 (10 日) 宣布，計劃透過發行股票籌資 150 億美元，藉由今年來股價大幅上漲的機會，為成本高昂的晶圓代工事業擴張計畫補充資金。
英特爾曾是全球半導體產業的主導者，如今正大舉投資新廠及先進封裝技術，希望在晶圓代工領域追趕台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 等市場領導者。建立先進製程產能需要投入龐大資本，這次股票發行將為其轉型及擴產計畫提供更多財務空間。
受到股票發行可能稀釋現有股東持股及每股獲利的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌逾 3%。不過，受惠於投資人看好公司重整及轉型進展，英特爾股價今年以來已上漲超過一倍，表現優於多數同業，也讓公司得以趁股價處於高檔時籌措資金。
根據發行安排，英特爾還將提供承銷商一項為期 30 天的選擇權，可按照發行價扣除承銷折扣後，額外購買最高 22.5 億美元的股票。若承銷商全數行使選擇權，英特爾此次籌資規模最高可達 172.5 億美元。
摩根大通證券、高盛、摩根士丹利及花旗環球金融將共同擔任本次股票發行的聯席簿記管理人。
paras_en: US chipmaker Intel (INTC-US) announced on Monday that it plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering, taking advantage of the significant price increase this year to supplement funds for its costly chip manufacturing expansion plans.

Intel, once the leader in the global semiconductor industry, is now heavily investing in new factories and advanced packaging technology in a bid to catch up with market leaders such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSM-US)(2330-TW). Building advanced process capacity requires massive capital investment, and this stock offering will provide more financial space for its transformation and expansion plans.

Intel's stock price fell over 3% on Monday ahead of the stock offering, due to concerns over the potential dilution of existing shareholders' stakes and earnings per share. However, investors are optimistic about the company's restructuring and transformation progress, which has led to a more than doubling of its stock price this year, outperforming many of its peers and enabling the company to raise funds at a high price.

Under the issuance arrangement, Intel will also provide underwriters with a 30-day option to purchase an additional $2.25 billion in stock, after deducting the underwriting discount from the issuance price. If the underwriters exercise the option in full, Intel's total fundraising scale could reach $17.25 billion.
Morgan Stanley Securities, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JPMorgan Chase will jointly serve as the joint bookrunners for this stock offering.

items.title: 才要升息又得救債市？日銀陷入最尷尬處境
paras: 日銀 (日本央行 / BOJ) 似乎正逐步朝提前升息邁進，但高市早苗政府的擴張性財政政策推升日本公債殖利率，也讓央行面臨日益升高的政治壓力。市場憂心，即使日銀調高政策利率，貨幣緊縮效果也可能因政府要求擴大購債、壓低長期利率而遭到抵銷。
隨著政府支出計畫推高殖利率，日銀正陷入一場棘手角力：一方面希望推動貨幣政策正常化，另一方面又必須抵抗要求恢復大規模購債的聲音，而購債恰恰是央行多年來試圖逐步退出的政策。
市場對首相高市早苗擴張性財政議程的疑慮，已推升日本政府公債殖利率，增加這個已開發國家中債務負擔最沉重經濟體的融資成本。日本殖利率上升對美國公債市場造成的外溢效應，也引發華府不滿。

高市政府緊盯殖利率 施壓日銀穩定債市

高市早苗上月承諾加強與市場溝通，以維持投資人對日本財政的信心。日本媒體報導，她在 5 月與日銀總裁植田和男會面時，曾要求央行必要時增加購債，以遏止長期利率上升。
高市早苗的盟友隨後接連表達對殖利率攀升及日銀縮減資產負債表的不安。由高市親自挑選加入政府顧問小組的經濟學家永濱利廣表示，相較於升息等傳統工具，高市政府更加重視貨幣政策的「量化層面」。
同屬再通膨派的經濟產業大臣木內稔，也曾警告日銀縮減資產負債表可能衝擊經濟，並敦促決策者優先維持市場穩定。部分分析師認為，政治壓力可能已影響政策，因為日銀在 6 月升息之際，同時決定自下個會計年度起暫停縮減購債計畫。
前日銀官員愛宕伸康警告，若要求央行在長期利率上升時買進公債，反而可能引發「財政支配」疑慮，使市場懷疑日銀是否仍有能力對抗通膨。高市早苗向來支持已故前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」，其核心之一便是透過大規模資產購買刺激物價及經濟成長。

殖利率逼近 3% 日銀恐被迫再次進場

對日銀而言，重新擴大購債將與多年來退出超寬鬆政策的努力背道而馳。央行 2024 年終止殖利率曲線控制 (YCC)，並啟動縮減購債計畫，希望恢復因長期大規模干預而失去活力的債券市場。
日銀強調，只有當殖利率以脫離經濟基本面的無序方式上升，並威脅金融穩定時，才會透過緊急操作增加購債。美國財長貝森特對日本政策的關切，可能使高市政府不敢公開反對提前升息，但日銀仍在強化抵禦政治施壓的論述。
日銀上周發布研究報告指出，推升公債殖利率的主要因素是通膨升高，而非央行減少購債。6 月會議紀錄也顯示，政策委員已開始討論日銀資產負債表的最終規模，表明央行儘管面臨壓力，仍希望延續政策正常化。
然而，市場最終仍可能迫使日銀出手。日本 10 年期公債殖利率周一升至 2.805%，逐漸逼近部分分析師視為新一波賣壓觸發點的 3%。
野村證券利率策略師岩下真理表示，若日本國內投資人需求不足導致殖利率急升，日銀可能別無選擇，只能進場干預。這正是央行長期以寬鬆政策主導債券市場，如今必須付出的代價。

items.title: 關稅戰前的搶運潮 美國7月貨櫃進口量創歷史第四高
items.title_en: Pre‑Tariff War Rush: U.S. July Container Imports Hit Historic Fourth‑Highest
paras: 根據供應鏈技術提供商 Descartes Systems Group 的最新數據，2026 年 7 月美國貨櫃進口量飆升至歷史第四高。分析師指出，這股增長並非源於終端消費需求的健康復甦，而是進口商為了規避即將到來的關稅變動及地緣政治風險，採取「提前搶運」策略所致。
數據顯示，美國港口在 7 月份處理了 250 萬個 20 呎標準貨櫃 (TEU)，雖然較 2025 年同期的近紀錄水準下降 4.3%，但仍遠高於疫情前水準。
這波搶運潮背景，是 7 月底到期的「122 條款」關稅，隨後被針對 60 個國家、最高達 12.5% 的新關稅所取代。儘管面臨長期的貿易爭端，來自中國的進口量在 7 月仍增至 87.3 萬 TEU，創下一年來的新高。
沃爾瑪 (WMT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 和家得寶 (HD-US) 等零售巨頭 (占美國貨櫃進口量約一半) 為了節省潛在的數百萬美元稅收，將傳統的秋冬航運旺季大幅提前。然而，這種急於在截止日期前清關的行為，導致了即期運費 (spot rates) 因艙位競爭而激增。
大量貨物湧入對美國港口基礎設施造成了嚴峻考驗。洛杉磯、長堤及薩凡納港面臨操作摩擦，包括卡車底盤短缺導致的貨物滯留，以及港口周邊倉儲空置率趨近於零的困境。
此外，美國市場的強勁需求導致空櫃過度集中在北美，引發亞洲出口中心的集裝箱短缺。這種設備失衡甚至波及新興市場，例如東非肯亞的進口成本因運力轉向跨太平洋航線而上漲，中國至東非的運費估計飆升了 25%。
分析師警告，當前的進口高峰是「不可持續的」，反映的是系統性的不確定性而非經濟實力。隨著關稅期限過去，預計第四季將出現劇烈的貿易收縮。航運業必須準備迎接「鐘擺效應」，屆時貨運量可能驟降，迫使船公司取消航次以支撐暴跌的運費。
paras_en: According to the latest data from supply‑chain technology provider Descartes Systems Group, U.S. container imports surged to a historic fourth‑highest level in July 2026. Analysts say the growth is not driven by a healthy rebound in end‑consumer demand, but by importers’ “early‑rush” strategy to avoid upcoming tariff changes and geopolitical risks.

The data show that U.S. ports handled 2.5 million standard 20‑foot containers (TEU) in July, a 4.3% decline from the near‑record level in the same month of 2025, yet still far above pre‑pandemic levels.

The rush is set against the backdrop of the “Section 122” tariff that expires at the end of July and is being replaced by new duties on 60 countries of up to 12.5%. Despite the long‑running trade dispute, imports from China rose to 873,000 TEU in July, a one‑year high.

Retail giants such as Walmart (WMT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Home Depot (HD‑US)—which together account for about half of U.S. container imports—have moved the traditional autumn‑winter shipping season forward to save potentially millions of dollars in taxes. This rush to clear goods before the deadline has driven spot rates sharply higher as carriers scramble for space.

The flood of cargo is putting severe strain on U.S. port infrastructure. Ports in Los Angeles, Long Beach and Savannah are experiencing operational frictions, including cargo backlogs caused by a shortage of truck chassis and near‑zero warehouse vacancy rates around the terminals.

In addition, strong domestic demand has left empty containers overly concentrated in North America, creating a shortage of containers at Asian export hubs. The equipment imbalance even affects emerging markets; for example, import costs in Kenya, East Africa have risen as capacity shifts to trans‑Pacific routes, with China‑to‑East Africa freight estimated to have jumped about 25%.

Analysts warn that the current import peak is “unsustainable,” reflecting systemic uncertainty rather than economic strength. With the tariff deadline passed, a sharp contraction in trade is expected in the fourth quarter, and the shipping industry must brace for a “pendulum effect” that could see freight volumes plunge and carriers cancel sailings to support collapsing rates.

items.title: 美股漲到沒人敢做空！華爾街FOMO全面失控
paras: 美股近期強勢突破新高，投資人害怕錯過行情的「FOMO」情緒正迅速升溫，選擇權市場多項指標甚至釋出數年來最樂觀的訊號。
中東緊張局勢降溫、油價回落，加上企業財報表現穩健，共同支撐美股走高，不過部分選擇權指標顯示，追漲情緒已成為推動本輪行情的一股獨立力量。
Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Mark Hackett 表示，市場上漲背後存在多項因素，但 FOMO 確實是其中之一。空頭原先依據的多項核心論點已經瓦解，無論是直接做空，或相對大盤減碼，對許多投資人而言都可能構成難以承受的落後風險。
標普 500 指數截至 8 月 4 日的四個交易日累計大漲 5.8%。在此之前，該指數約三個月來僅在 5.7% 的區間內波動，遠低於 2006 年以來滾動三個月平均 12.5% 的震盪幅度。考量人工智慧 (AI) 類股 7 月底才經歷一波沉重賣壓，這次快速反彈顯得更加猛烈。

追漲買盤湧入 看漲選擇權需求急升

過去多年來，每逢市場回檔便進場買進的投資人往往獲得回報，如今「逢低買進」的慣性再度浮現，各項衡量投資人追逐上漲行情的指標也同步升溫。
《路透》根據 Trade Alert 數據分析顯示，標普 500 看漲選擇權與看跌選擇權的一個月平均每日成交量比率已升至 0.9，寫下至少四年來最偏多的水準之一。
Susquehanna Financial Group 的分析則顯示，衡量投資人願意為短期急漲押注支付多少溢價的標普 500 短天期看漲偏斜指標，上周攀升至兩年新高。這反映投資人購買上漲部位的意願，明顯高於防範市場下跌的需求。
市場廣度同樣出現過熱跡象。LPL Financial 首席技術策略師 Adam Turnquist 指出，追蹤標普 500 成分股多頭技術型態占比的「看漲百分比指數」已突破 70%，進入超買區域。
Interactive Brokers 首席策略師 Steve Sosnick 表示，FOMO 從未真正消失，只是先前並非市場焦點。部分機構投資人擔心的並非股市下跌，而是錯過漲勢、績效落後，因此買進上漲部位更像是一種避免被行情拋下的「保險」。

股漲、波動率也升 過熱訊號藏反轉風險

另一項不尋常現象是，通常在股市上漲時走低的波動率指標，近期部分交易日卻與股價同步攀升。以 8 月 4 日為例，標普 500 單日大漲近 2%，芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數 (VIX) 反而上升近 1 點。
OptionMetrics 量化研究主管 Garrett DeSimone 指出，當市場對看漲選擇權的需求極為強勁時，即使股價上漲，VIX 仍可能同步走高。分析師認為，這種現象顯示部分投資人可能先前配置不足，如今正急於透過選擇權追趕錯過的行情，而非有秩序地布局後續漲勢。
Susquehanna 策略師 Christopher Jacobson 表示，波動率與看漲偏斜指標同時上升，意味投資人普遍低配股票，面臨市場上漲時績效落後的風險，因此必須積極搶進看漲選擇權。
不過，部分投資人將這些指標視為反向訊號，認為當追漲情緒急速升溫時，市場反而應提高警覺。DeSimone 警告，投資人可能因強勢反彈而認定利空已經消除，但本輪漲勢的部分強度，其實可能來自選擇權市場的技術性因素。
儘管 FOMO 使市場浮現泡沫化跡象，多頭仍有強勁經濟基本面及 AI 投資需求支撐。Ameriprise 首席市場策略師 Anthony Saglimbene 表示，槓桿風險及美股年底前還能上漲多少仍有爭議，但美國市場的基本面依舊建立在相當穩固的基礎上。

items.title: 散戶對SpaceX看法出現重大變化！上市後首度轉為淨賣出「逢低買進」開始變成「反彈減碼」
items.title_en: Retail Investors’ Views on SpaceX Shift Dramatically! First Net Sell‑off Since IPO Turns “Buy the Dip” Into “Sell on the Rally"
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 一路力挺SpaceX的散戶，態度開始變了。根據Vanda Research最新統計，散戶8月7日淨賣出SpaceX股票450萬美元，是6月12日上市以來第一次由買轉賣，顯示部分投資人可能已從「跌了就買」轉向「漲了先賣」。
更值得注意的是，散戶不是在股價大跌時出逃，而是在股價強勁反彈、重新接近$135的IPO價格時選擇減碼。eToro市場分析師Sam North認為，這比較像是投資人趁反彈先減碼，而不是全部撤出。
就在8月5日SpaceX股價重挫13.6%時，散戶還在積極進場撿便宜，當天淨買入規模是上市以來第四高，但短短幾天後，資金方向就首次翻轉。
不過，散戶目前還談不上大舉撤退。8月7日淨賣出450萬美元，相較6月16日單日淨買入1.45億美元仍很小。真正值得注意的是，原本一路買進的散戶，第一次開始轉為賣超。
此外，散戶態度轉變可能還有兩個原因。
首先是財報。SpaceX最新財報公布後，市場發現公司資本支出明顯增加，代表未來還要投入大量資金，也讓投資人意識到，這些投資要轉化為獲利可能需要更長時間。對期待快速看到回報的散戶來說，等待時間拉長，自然也降低繼續追價的意願。
隨著SpaceX首批股票鎖定期限制到期，可在市場交易的股票數量增加超過一倍。如果散戶買盤也持續降溫，在股票供給增加、接手意願減弱的情況下，SpaceX上市以來的資金面支撐也可能進一步轉弱。

paras_en: August 10, 2026 (Yōu Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – Retail investors who have been staunch supporters of SpaceX are changing their stance. According to the latest statistics from Vanda Research, retail investors net‑sold $4.5 million of SpaceX stock on August 7, marking the first time since the June 12 IPO that buying turned into selling, suggesting some investors may have moved from “buy on the dip” to “sell on the rise.”

What is noteworthy is that retail investors are not fleeing during a sharp price drop; they are trimming positions as the stock makes a strong rebound and approaches the $135 IPO price again. eToro market analyst Sam North says this looks more like investors taking profits on the bounce rather than exiting completely.

On August 5, when SpaceX shares plunged 13.6 %, retail investors were still actively buying the dip, with net purchases that day ranking fourth‑highest since the IPO. Yet just a few days later, the flow direction reversed for the first time.

However, retail investors are not yet pulling out en masse. The $4.5 million net sell on August 7 is still tiny compared with the $145 million net buy recorded on June 16, and the real signal is that retail buyers, who had been consistently adding, are now selling more than buying for the first time.
There are also two other factors that may be driving the shift in retail sentiment.

First, the earnings report. After SpaceX released its latest financials, the market saw a clear rise in capital expenditures, indicating that the company will need to invest a large amount of money going forward. This makes investors realize that turning those investments into profit could take longer, dampening the appetite of retail investors who were hoping for quick returns.

Second, the lock‑up period for the first batch of SpaceX shares is expiring, more than doubling the number of shares available for trading. If retail buying continues to cool, the increased supply and weaker demand could further erode the funding support that has underpinned the stock since its debut.

items.title: 淨利翻倍至256.7億美元仍唱空？《大賣空》本尊：不再認為波克夏是未來有吸引力的投資
items.title_en: Net Profit Doubles to $25.67 B Yet Still Short? Michael Burry, the Real‑Life ‘Big Short’ Figure, No Longer Sees Berkshire as an Attractive Investment
paras: 好萊塢電影《大賣空》原型人物、知名投資人 Michael Burry 上週表示，當初最擔心「股神」巴菲特退位後繼任者「年紀偏大、終究不是巴菲特，沒那種只揮最佳一棒耐心」的話已經成真，並指波克夏海瑟威未來不再是有吸引力的投資。
話音落下隔日，波克夏剛交出一份「數字很亮眼、敘事很微妙」的 2026 年 Q2 財報。
根據波克夏上週六 (8 日) 披露的財報成績單，該公司 Q2 歸屬於股東淨利 256.7 億美元，較去年同期 123.7 億幾近翻倍，主因權益投資未實現收益回彈。剔除此項目後，營業利潤 129.8 億美元，年增 16.3%，其中製造、服務與零售組合利潤成長 24% 至 44.7 億美元，Geico 拖累保險承保利潤下滑。
巴菲特以往屢屢提醒說：「淨利受公允價值波動干擾，營業利潤才是本業溫度計。
真正讓市場側目的是「錢開始動了」。今年 Q2 波克夏買股 235 億、賣股 37 億，三年多來首度股票淨買入，且同步回購 A 股 478 股、B 股逾 800 萬股，耗資約 45 億美元，較今年 Q1 的 2.34 億明顯加碼，但仍低於市場 50-110 億預期。
在 6 月底為止一季，波克夏的現金及美債部位達 3647 億美元，季減 4%，為四年來首見，同期該公司還斥資 68 億美元收購建商 Taylor Morrison(7 月才交割、未入 Q2 財報)，並簽下谷歌 800 億籌資案中的 100 億私募協議。
今年 1 月，巴菲特交出 60 年權杖，阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 正式上任波克夏執行長一職、巴菲特留任董事長。
Burry 質疑的正是這道縫隙：阿貝爾肯不肯像巴菲特那樣「忍住不買」，但反方論點認為 Q2 營業利潤雙位數增、現金開始流向回購與淨買股、前五大持倉 (蘋果、美國運通、美銀、可口可樂、Alphabet) 仍緊抱現金流龍頭。
Lountzis 資產管理總裁 Paul Lountzis 則表示，私募市場目前非常瘋狂、公開市場也有些不理性，「很難要求阿貝爾現在進行巨型交易」，投資人仍願給時間。
伯克希爾股價 Q2 僅漲 4.28%，落後標普 500 的 14.87%——伯里的冷評與市場的猶豫，本質是同一件事：傳奇交班後，市場要的不再是「下一個巴菲特」，而是證明阿貝爾用 3647 億美元也能打出好球。（
paras_en: Hollywood film “The Big Short” was based on Michael Burry, a well‑known investor, who said last week that his biggest worry – that after Warren Buffett steps down his successor would be “older, not Buffett, and lack the patience to swing the best bat” – has already come true, and he now views Berkshire Hathaway as no longer an attractive investment.
The day after his comments, Berkshire just released a 2026 Q2 earnings report that was “numerically impressive but narratively subtle.”

According to the earnings slip Berkshire disclosed on Saturday (the 8th), its Q2 net profit attributable to shareholders was $25.67 billion, almost double the $12.37 billion a year earlier, driven mainly by a rebound in unrealized gains on equity investments. Excluding that item, operating profit was $12.98 billion, up 16.3% year‑over‑year, with manufacturing, services and retail contributing $4.47 billion – a 24% rise – while Geico weighed on insurance underwriting profit.
Buffett has repeatedly warned that “net profit is distorted by fair‑value fluctuations; operating profit is the true temperature gauge of the business.”

What really caught the market’s eye was that “the money started moving.” In Q2 this year Berkshire bought $23.5 billion of stock and sold $3.7 billion, marking the first net stock purchase in more than three years, and simultaneously repurchased 478 million Class A shares and over 8 million Class B shares for about $4.5 billion – a clear step‑up from the $2.34 billion in Q1, though still below analysts’ $5‑$11 billion expectations.

As of the end of June, Berkshire’s cash and U.S. Treasury holdings stood at $364.7 billion, down 4% quarter‑over‑quarter – the first decline in four years. In the same period the company also spent $6.8 billion to acquire homebuilder Taylor Morrison (closing in July, not reflected in Q2 results) and signed a private‑placement agreement for $10 billion of the $80 billion Google financing deal.
In January this year Buffett passed the 60‑year baton to Greg Abel, who officially became Berkshire’s CEO while Buffett remains chairman.

Burry’s criticism targets that very gap: whether Abel will exercise the same restraint Buffett showed by “holding back on buying.” Opponents argue that Q2 operating profit grew double‑digits, cash is flowing into buybacks and net stock purchases, and the top five holdings – Apple, American Express, Bank of America, Coca‑Cola and Alphabet – remain tightly tied to cash‑flow powerhouses.

Paul Lountzis, president of Lountzis Asset Management, said the private‑equity market is currently “very crazy” and the public market is somewhat irrational, making it “hard to demand that Abel execute massive deals right now,” and investors are still willing to give him time.

Berkshire’s stock rose only 4.28% in Q2, lagging the S&P 500’s 14.87% gain – Burry’s cool assessment and the market’s hesitation stem from the same issue: after the legend hands over the reins, the market no longer wants “the next Buffett,” but proof that Abel can deliver strong results even with $364.7 billion on the balance sheet.

items.title: 英特爾趁股價翻倍啟動150億美元募資 擴大晶圓代工與先進封裝投資
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering Amid Surging Share Price
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國晶片大廠英特爾Intel(INTC-US)周一宣布，計畫透過發行股票籌集150億美元資金。隨著公司轉型策略帶動今年股價大幅上漲，英特爾選擇把握股價走強時機籌措資金，以支應資本密集度高的晶圓代工業務擴張。
英特爾過去曾是全球晶片產業的主導廠商，但近年面臨競爭加劇，公司正投入大量資金興建新廠，並強化先進封裝能力，希望擴大晶圓代工市場版圖，與產業龍頭台積電(2330-TW)競爭。
受到新股發行可能稀釋既有股東持股的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌超過3%。不過，在轉型題材推動下，英特爾今年以來股價已上漲超過一倍，表現優於同業，也為公司此時進行大規模股權募資提供有利條件。
根據募資規劃，英特爾將允許承銷商在未來30天內，視市場需求額外購買最多22.5億美元的英特爾股票。如果市場認購反應熱絡、承銷商全數行使這項權利，英特爾最終透過此次股票發行籌集的資金規模，最高募資金額可達172.5億美元。
英特爾Intel先前預期2026年資本支出約與2025年持平，但隨著AI帶動CPU需求升溫，訂單已超過現有製造產能，公司因此在7月將2026年資本支出預估從180億上調至200億美元，加快擴充產能。
相較之下，此次基本募資規模已接近公司一整年的資本支出，對現有股東來說，大規模發行新股將增加流通在外股數，在其他條件不變下，將對每股盈餘帶來稀釋壓力；但從另一個角度來看，公司積極募資，也代表英特爾正在為後續投資預先準備資金，市場將關注這是否反映公司對未來訂單能見度更有信心，並可能進一步上修資本支出、加快擴產腳步。
英特爾近年持續增加新製程、晶圓廠設備與先進封裝相關投資，希望透過擴充製造能力重新建立競爭優勢。今年股價大幅反彈，也讓公司得以把握股價走高的機會，透過資本市場籌措更多資金，降低大規模擴產對自身現金部位帶來的壓力。

paras_en: On August 10, 2026, Intel (INTC-US), a US chip giant, announced plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering. With the company's transformation strategy driving a significant surge in its stock price this year, Intel is taking advantage of the strong market to raise funds for its capital-intensive foundry business expansion.

Intel, once the dominant player in the global chip industry, has faced increasing competition in recent years. The company is investing heavily in building new factories and strengthening its advanced packaging capabilities to expand its foundry market share and compete with industry leader TSMC (2330-TW).

Intel's stock price fell by over 3% in pre-market trading on Monday due to concerns that the new stock offering might dilute existing shareholders' holdings. However, driven by its transformation, Intel's stock price has more than doubled this year, outperforming its peers and providing favorable conditions for the company's large-scale equity financing.

According to the fundraising plan, Intel will allow underwriters to purchase an additional $2.25 billion of its stock within the next 30 days, depending on market demand. If the market response is strong and the underwriters exercise this option in full, Intel's total fundraising amount could reach $17.25 billion.

Intel had previously expected its 2026 capital expenditures to be similar to those in 2025. However, with AI-driven CPU demand heating up, orders have exceeded current manufacturing capacity, prompting the company to revise its 2026 capital expenditure estimate from $18 billion to $20 billion in July to accelerate capacity expansion.

In comparison, the basic fundraising amount is close to the company's annual capital expenditure. For existing shareholders, the large-scale issuance of new shares will increase the number of outstanding shares, which may lead to a dilution of earnings per share, assuming other conditions remain unchanged. On the other hand, the company's proactive fundraising efforts may indicate that Intel is preparing funds for future investments, and the market will be watching to see if this reflects the company's increased confidence in its future orders and potential further expansion.

Intel has been increasing its investments in new processes, wafer factory equipment, and advanced packaging in recent years to re-establish its competitive advantage through expanded manufacturing capabilities. This year's significant stock price rebound has also enabled the company to take advantage of the high stock price to raise more funds through the capital market, reducing the pressure on its cash position due to large-scale expansion.

items.title: 全球近9成人形機器人來自中國宇樹、智元、樂聚今年搶上市
items.title_en: Global Humanoid Robot Market Led by Chinese Companies Unitree, AgiBot, and Leju Robotics
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 從全球人形機器人競爭格局觀察，2025年出貨量前6大業者均為中國企業，合計占全球出貨量87.87%。其中宇樹科技(Unitree)與智元機器人(AgiBot)合計占71.99%，其後依序為優必選UBTECH(9880-HK)的7.27%、樂聚機器人的3.89%、眾擎機器人(Engine AI)的2.70%，以及傅利葉智能(Fourier Intelligence)的2.02%。
其中，2026年已明確推進上市計畫的公司包括宇樹科技、樂聚機器人與智元機器人。宇樹科技目前進度最快，已完成上海科創板IPO定價，發行價為每股150.8元人民幣，預計募資61億元人民幣，並於2026年8月10日開放申購，可望成為中國首家在A股掛牌的人形機器人製造商。
樂聚機器人則是於2026年5月申請在深圳創業板上市，成為另一家正式向資本市場邁進的人形機器人業者；智元機器人則於2026年7月啟動香港IPO準備工作，市場持續關注是否能在2026年內推進至正式申請階段。
這波上市潮反映中國人形機器人業者為支應研發、AI模型、訓練資料及製造產能所需的大量資金，正加速透過公開市場取得長期資本。
若從競爭定位來看，宇樹科技(Unitree)、智元機器人(AgiBot)與樂聚機器人(Leju Robotics)雖然同樣布局人形機器人，但發展路線各有側重。
宇樹科技的優勢在於硬體成本控制與供應鏈垂直整合，從四足機器人一路延伸至G1、H1及R1等人形機器人，主打高性價比與快速量產；智元機器人則更強調AI模型的實用性，以及與工業場景的技術整合能力，產品涵蓋人形機器人、工業機器人及靈巧操作系統，2026年上半年交付約8,400台，規模已超越宇樹，並積極拓展工業與海外市場。
樂聚機器人的規模相對較小，主要以「夸父」(Kuavo)人形機器人切入工業、教育與服務場景，並透過與東方精工(002611-CN)等企業合作建立量產能力。

paras_en: According to a report by Industry Data Center, as of 2025, the top 6 humanoid robot manufacturers globally are all Chinese companies, accounting for 87.87% of the global market share. Unitree and AgiBot combined account for 71.99%, followed by UBTECH (9880-HK) at 7.27%, Leju Robotics at 3.89%, Engine AI at 2.70%, and Fourier Intelligence at 2.02%.

Among them, companies that have already announced their plans to go public in 2026 include Unitree, Leju Robotics, and AgiBot. Unitree is currently the most advanced, having completed its IPO pricing on the Shanghai Science and Technology Board, with a listing price of 150.8 yuan per share, and plans to raise 61 billion yuan, with subscription opening on August 10, 2026, and aiming to become China's first humanoid robot manufacturer listed on the A-share market.

Leju Robotics, on the other hand, applied for listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in May 2026, becoming another humanoid robot manufacturer to take its first step towards the capital market; AgiBot has started preparing for its Hong Kong IPO in July 2026, with the market continuing to watch whether it can progress to the formal application stage by the end of 2026.

This wave of listings reflects the need for Chinese humanoid robot manufacturers to secure large amounts of capital to support research and development, AI model development, training data, and manufacturing capacity.
From a competitive positioning perspective, Unitree, AgiBot, and Leju Robotics all have different development routes, despite being in the same humanoid robot market.

Unitree's strengths lie in its hardware cost control and vertical integration of the supply chain, from four-legged robots to G1, H1, and R1 humanoid robots, focusing on high value-for-money and rapid mass production.

AgiBot, on the other hand, emphasizes the practicality of its AI models and its ability to integrate technology with industrial scenarios, with products covering humanoid robots, industrial robots, and dexterous operation systems. In the first half of 2026, it delivered approximately 8,400 units, surpassing Unitree in scale and actively expanding into the industrial and overseas markets.

Leju Robotics has a relatively smaller scale, mainly entering the industrial, education, and service scenarios with its 'Kuavo' humanoid robot, and establishing mass production capabilities through partnerships with companies such as Eastar Precision (002611-CN).

items.title: 那指出現創立以來僅18次的罕見信號 這通常意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Rare Signal Triggers in Nasdaq Composite Index
paras: 科技股雲集的那斯達克綜合指數，近期觸發了一個極為罕見的技術信號。自此指數於 1971 年成立以來，此信號僅出現過 18 次，根據歷史經驗，這往往預示著股市在未來一年內將出現驚人的漲幅。

罕見的「連四紅」漲勢

在經歷了 7 月份短暫回落至修正區間的邊緣後，美股隨即被點燃。從 7 月 30 日開始至 8 月 4 日收盤，那斯達克綜合指數連續 4 個交易日每日漲幅均至少達到 1%。這是指數成立 55 年來，第 18 次達成此項壯舉。
根據 Bespoke Investment Group 研究數據，在過去 17 次出現這種連續 4 天漲幅逾 1% 的情況後，那斯達克指數在接下來的一年裡平均飆升了 29.3%，這項數據遠高於該指數過去 55 年來不到 11% 的平均年回報率。

AI 革命與企業盈利雙重驅動

推動 2026 年這波牛市的核心動力，主要來自人工智慧 (AI) 革命以及優於預期的企業盈餘增長。截至 8 月 6 日收盤，那斯達克指數今年以來已上漲 13.4%，領先於標普 500 指數的 12.6% 以及道瓊工業平均指數的 12.1%。
市場分析指出，如果歷史規律再次發揮作用，那斯達克指數有望在 2027 年 8 月前突破 34,000 點大關。
然而，要實現這一歷史性目標，市場需要滿足幾個關鍵條件。首先，AI 基礎設施的建設必須持續推進。目前的 AI 晶片、記憶體與伺服器支出雖然處於高位，但由於許多建設是透過債務融資，若聯準會 (Fed) 持續升息導致借貸成本過高，可能會拖累相關支出。

估值過高與潛在風險

儘管前景樂觀，但投資者仍需保持警惕。目前的股市定價已處於溢價狀態，標普 500 指數的席勒本益比 (Shiller P/E Ratio) 在 6 月初曾一度接近 43，這是歷史上第二貴的市場估值，僅次於網路泡沫時期。這意味著企業必須展現出「近乎完美」的執行力與獲利增長，才能支撐如此高昂的估值。
此外，全球市場的連鎖反應也不容忽視。例如南韓 KOSPI 指數近期出現如「迷因股」般的劇烈波動，這被視為美股潛在的外部風險之一。
paras_en: The Nasdaq Composite Index, which is heavily weighted with tech stocks, recently triggered a rare technical signal. This signal has only appeared 18 times since the index was established in 1971, and historically, it has often predicted a stunning surge in stock prices over the next year.
The rare 'four red' rally

After a brief dip to the correction zone in July, the US stock market was ignited. From July 30 to August 4, the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by at least 1% every day for four consecutive trading days. This is the 18th time the index has achieved this feat in its 55-year history.

According to data from Bespoke Investment Group, in the 17 previous instances where the Nasdaq Composite Index rose by more than 1% for four consecutive days, the index averaged a 29.3% surge over the next year. This is significantly higher than the index's average annual return of less than 11% over the past 55 years.
AI revolution and corporate earnings drive the bull market

The core driver of the 2026 bull market is the AI revolution and better-than-expected corporate earnings growth. As of August 6, the Nasdaq Composite Index has risen 13.4% this year, outperforming the S&P 500 Index's 12.6% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average's 12.1%.
Market analysts say that if historical patterns hold, the Nasdaq Composite Index could break through the 34,000-point barrier by August 2027.

However, to achieve this historic goal, the market must meet several key conditions. First, the construction of AI infrastructure must continue to advance. Although current spending on AI chips, memory, and servers is at a high level, many of these investments are financed through debt, and if the Federal Reserve continues to raise interest rates, leading to high borrowing costs, it could slow down related spending.

items.title: 挑戰台積電還要更多銀彈！英特爾發股募資150億美元
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering to Fund Chip Expansion
paras: 美國晶片大廠英特爾 (Intel)(INTC-US) 周一 (10 日) 宣布，計劃透過發行股票籌資 150 億美元，藉由今年來股價大幅上漲的機會，為成本高昂的晶圓代工事業擴張計畫補充資金。
英特爾曾是全球半導體產業的主導者，如今正大舉投資新廠及先進封裝技術，希望在晶圓代工領域追趕台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 等市場領導者。建立先進製程產能需要投入龐大資本，這次股票發行將為其轉型及擴產計畫提供更多財務空間。
受到股票發行可能稀釋現有股東持股及每股獲利的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌逾 3%。不過，受惠於投資人看好公司重整及轉型進展，英特爾股價今年以來已上漲超過一倍，表現優於多數同業，也讓公司得以趁股價處於高檔時籌措資金。
根據發行安排，英特爾還將提供承銷商一項為期 30 天的選擇權，可按照發行價扣除承銷折扣後，額外購買最高 22.5 億美元的股票。若承銷商全數行使選擇權，英特爾此次籌資規模最高可達 172.5 億美元。
摩根大通證券、高盛、摩根士丹利及花旗環球金融將共同擔任本次股票發行的聯席簿記管理人。
paras_en: US chipmaker Intel (INTC-US) announced on Monday that it plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering, taking advantage of the significant price increase this year to supplement funds for its costly chip manufacturing expansion plans.

Intel, once the leader in the global semiconductor industry, is now heavily investing in new factories and advanced packaging technology in a bid to catch up with market leaders such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSM-US)(2330-TW). Building advanced process capacity requires massive capital investment, and this stock offering will provide more financial space for its transformation and expansion plans.

Intel's stock price fell over 3% on Monday ahead of the stock offering, due to concerns over the potential dilution of existing shareholders' stakes and earnings per share. However, investors are optimistic about the company's restructuring and transformation progress, which has led to a more than doubling of its stock price this year, outperforming many of its peers and enabling the company to raise funds at a high price.

Under the issuance arrangement, Intel will also provide underwriters with a 30-day option to purchase an additional $2.25 billion in stock, after deducting the underwriting discount from the issuance price. If the underwriters exercise the option in full, Intel's total fundraising scale could reach $17.25 billion.
Morgan Stanley Securities, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JPMorgan Chase will jointly serve as the joint bookrunners for this stock offering.
